title: PDV Phase 7 hidden shrine and Civil War closeout contract
notes: This manifest records the Phase 7 Nord/Imperial signal expansion contract and its current retirement notes for the hidden Talos shrine receiver plus the final Civil War compliance/defiance one-shot packet.
pdv_author cannot mint or relocate placed references, ACTI, QUST, INFO, or player-alias records, so shrine-reference wiring and Civil War hook wiring remain manual CK/xEdit work.

A future hidden Talos route needs a new non-rendered or otherwise visually audited receiver contract before strict-phase7 can promote it again. Civil War fragment wiring is documented here and in the dedicated checklist, but remains runtime-smoke proof rather than strict-verifier readback.

The live framework baseline now has both Civil War hooks wired and runtime-proven: CW01A stage 200 compliance logged EventBus adjustment 15 at 2026-05-20 16:38:24 AEST, and CW01B stage 200 defiance logged EventBus adjustment -15 at 2026-05-20 16:42:44 AEST.
unsupported: Do not restore PDV_REFR_TalosShrineDefianceSignal on 10753E:Skyrim.esm. The 2026-06-16 cleanup removed Devotion.esp's override so the vanilla Windhelm shrine reference wins unchanged.

Do not create a visible helper ACTI or attach PDV_EventSignalActivator to visible shrine geometry for the hidden Talos route. Any replacement must be non-rendered or explicitly visual-audited in game.

Local Civil War confirmation is now complete: CW01A (Skyrim.esm:0D517A, Joining the Legion) and CW01B (Skyrim.esm:0E2D29, Joining the Stormcloaks) both expose objective 160 'Take the oath' and complete at stage 200.

Do not guess alternate Civil War hooks from prose, do not broaden into crime/arrest Story Manager events in Phase 7, and do not add Talos award on the Civil War join fragments.
